subject.title: feat: bound transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw adopt schema v13 transcript-generation state and public raw/visible cursor APIs as a supported Plugin SDK contract, rather than keeping bounded reads as an internal active-memory optimization?
rationale: The repository policy requires explicit acceptance for SQLite schema-version bumps, and only maintainers can decide whether these new public SDK semantics are a durable supported surface.

options.title: Sponsor the shared cursor foundation
options.body: Explicitly approve schema v13 and the public raw/visible cursor contracts, then continue review with migration and SDK compatibility evidence.

options.title: Narrow to the current owner
options.body: Rework the change so active-memory bounds its own inspection without adding a schema migration or general Plugin SDK cursor API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared cursor foundation
recommendation.body: Explicitly approve schema v13 and the public raw/visible cursor contracts, then continue review with migration and SDK compatibility evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the technical proposal and its dependent stack, so is the best available routing contact for obtaining the required maintainer sponsorship.
